lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy2Cu10Sn2 (DyCu5Sn) is tetragonal with space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143), containing 14 atoms per unit cell across 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Cu centers with 12 neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, alongside Cu–Cu and Cu–Sn contacts, while Dy and Sn centers each have 20 geometric neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Cu 12-vertex and Dy 20-vertex polyhedra, and between Cu 12-vertex polyhedra, forming a 3-periodic connectivity network.
